WHO Launches Global Campaign To Counter 'Medical Excuse Marijuana' Deception

Not yet. But hopefully very soon. Under the wise leadership of former Norwegian Prime Minister, Dr. Gro Harlem Brundtland, a campaign called "Smoking Crude Marijuana is Dangerous - Don´t be Duped, should be launched to counter 'medical excuse marijuana' deception around the world.

HNN is looking forward to a campaign that brings together senior health and media activists from countries worldwide to join forces with honest scientists, who long ago realized that smoking crude marijuana has nothing to do with medicine, to expose the Marijuana Snake Oil Ltd worldwide campaign of deception and lies.
